title: The Secret Reason You Always Pick the Middle Choice
hook: Three choices appear. Your brain already knows its favourite.

narration.text: When presented with three options, you are far more likely to choose the middle one.
This is called the compromise effect, and it shapes many of our decisions.
We see the middle option as a safe compromise, avoiding extremes.
It feels like a balanced choice, not too cheap and not too expensive.
This cognitive bias reduces the perceived risk of making a bad decision.
Businesses often use this to guide customers towards a specific product.
Notice this next time you are choosing a coffee or a subscription plan.
Have you ever noticed yourself falling for this trick?

description: Discover why our brains often gravitate towards the middle option when given three choices. This psychological phenomenon, known as the compromise effect, influences many of our daily decisions. Understanding it can help you make more conscious choices.
topic: Why you tend to choose the middle option when presented with three choices, explaining the compromise effect.
